title: The Relationship of Space Adaptation Syndrome to Middle Cerebral Artery Blood Velocity Measured in Flight by Doppler
archive_status: Data preservation is complete. All datasets are publicly available.
notes: Downloaded: tabular files (xls/xlsx/csv/txt) and PDF reports up to 50 MB. Every Excel sheet is also saved as '<file>__<sheet>.csv' (raw cell grid, no header detection).
Not downloaded: figure images (tif/jpg) - they are rendered graphs; their URLs are listed under skipped_files.
Downloaded files are untrusted data: parse only, never open macros / execute.
Downloaded the only file (PDF, 1 page) - it contains just the LSDA header (PI, missions STS-29/34/42, title); NO data. Middle cerebral artery Doppler velocity is not HR/BP anyway.

files.dataset_name: Relationship between SMS and middle cerebral artery blood flow velocities during spaceflight
files.dataset_description: Relationship between SMS and middle cerebral artery blood flow velocities during spaceflight as shown in 8 subjects.  Source: Bagian JP, Hackett P. Cerebral blood flow: comparison of ground-based and spaceflight data and correlation with space adaptation syndrome. J Clin Pharmacol. 1991 Oct;31(10):1036-40.
